every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 hides the text cards cleanly during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D subject is unobstructed, whereas Site 2 leaves partially faded cards overlapping the 3D rack in frame 4.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor—showing token slabs compressed by a digest press in frames 3–5, stored in an anchor rack in frame 6, and routed across seven host lanes in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the identical well-crafted 3D scene with beveled dark metal machinery, matte colored blocks, grounded grid shadows, and crisp spatial labels across frames 1–9.

type_and_layout.reason: While both share the same clean card typography in frames 1–3, 5–6, and 8–9, Site 1 avoids the dim, illegible mid-fade text cards that clutter Site 2's frames 4 and 7.

overall.reason: Although both sites share the same strong 3D visualization and design, Site 1 executes cleaner scroll transitions without half-faded UI cards obscuring the 3D machinery.
